description:
## 1.0.0

First release: **Allow Gearslip** lets Gearslip show Waze on the car screen.

> ⚠️ Written entirely by AI and untested against a real Waze APK. Use at your own risk.

patches.name: Allow Gearslip
patches.description: Lets Gearslip, the Android Auto alternative, show Waze on the car screen. Waze's car library accepts only Android Auto itself on a phone; this adds Gearslip (and any other host you list) to the hosts it accepts. Android Auto keeps working as before.

options.description: digest,package entries separated by ';'. The digest is the SHA-256 of the host's signing certificate, 64 lowercase hex characters (apksigner verify --print-certs), or * for any certificate.

release_notes:
> [!CAUTION]
> **This release was written entirely by AI (Claude) and has not been tested against a real Waze APK or in a real car.** Use at your own risk. Read the README before you use it.

First release of **Allow Gearslip**: lets [Gearslip](https://github.com/Seb3thehacker/gearslip) host Waze's car screen by adding it to the hosts Waze's Car App Library accepts. Android Auto keeps working as before.

- Target: Waze 5.24.5.0 (APKM); other versions experimental
- Patcher: morphe-patcher 1.13.0
- Asset SHA-256: `9fa1fce85b78fede53cf6893b9515e2b2f1302300efae5d6fe1d78c0d3ecce39`

Add to Morphe Manager: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=VoltoxderEchte/waze-gearslip-morphe-patch
